text: Goonga tigi, Min okkii Muusaa Tawreeta, Min ndewni heen nulaaɓe ɓaawo makko, noon kadi Min okkii Iisaa ɓii Maryam maandeeji ɓannguɗi laɓɓinooji goonɗude mo, wano wuurtinde maayɓe, e sellinde bempiloowo (mbo yi'ataa jamma) e ñawu daneyel, Min cemmbiniri mo Malayka Jibriil (jwm) mbela -onon ɓiɓɓe Isra'il- kala nde nulaaɗo Alla addi e mon ko yahdaani e belaaɗe mon calo-ɗon goonga o, mawnikino-ɗon ɓurno-ɗon nulaaɓe Alla ɓe, yoga heen njeddon ɓe woɓɓe heen mbaron ɓe.
